_provenance: Supplemental layer for pre-1980s/discontinued American makes and motorcycle makes that NHTSA's vPIC catalog (vpic.nhtsa.dot.gov) under-covers (vPIC's model data is strongest from roughly the 1980s onward — see fetch_vpic.py's header). Compiled from well-established, broadly-documented automotive history, then cross-checked against each make's Wikipedia 'List of <Make> vehicles' page (or equivalent) via verify_curated_classic.py, which fetches the live page and confirms every model name below is actually present in it. Wikipedia's own prose/text is CC BY-SA licensed and is NOT copied here — only the bare fact 'this make produced a model with this name' is used, which is not copyrightable subject matter (a model name/nameplate is a fact, not creative expression). Model names are base nameplates only, no trim level (e.g. 'Charger', not 'Charger R/T') — matches how vPIC itself represents models. Motorcycle makes were sourced this way because vPIC's own motorcycle make list (1,684 entries) was spot-checked and found dominated by one-off custom/chopper builders, not useful for a car-show seed list.
_motorcycle_note: Makes here that ALSO make cars/trucks (e.g. Honda, BMW, Suzuki, Triumph already come from vPIC's car list) get their motorcycle models MERGED into that same make entry by merge_seed_source.py's case-insensitive name match — a judge must see exactly one 'Honda,' not a separate 'Honda' and 'Honda Motorcycle.' Only genuinely motorcycle-only makes end up as new entries.
